original_target.title: Attainment of the three-dimensional neo-Hookean energy in the regular admissible class

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.

sources.scope: Strict gap between infimum on regular class and infimum on its weak closure, under extra H growth bounds; does not show original infimum fails attainment.
Modified F includes singular inverse derivative on enlarged BV-inverse class. Compactness and lower semicontinuity of F; original regular-class attainment becomes an additional regularity problem.
Inverse regularity and conclusions require INV or additional admissible-class hypotheses.

scope_comparison: Must attain original E in displayed divergence-identity class for every permissible convex H and boundary data. Gap between two infima alone does not refute attainment within the smaller class.
